description: Houston-based team led by a USAMO qualifier and Codeforces Candidate Master with research experience in ML, optimization, and dynamical systems. We want to ship a working tool built on NASA open data by Sunday. Looking for teammates strong in web or front-end development, data visualization, graphic design, or presenting and storytelling. Beginners who can commit to both days are welcome. Message us with your skills and the challenge that interests you most.
